liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): Band bolted out of the gate with a fantastic performance [13]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Described as one of the many killer versions from 1971 [18]
- **Empty Pages** (1 review): Rare appearance; Dicks Picks holds the only other known recording [19]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): Surprise song described as a rare treat from nowhere [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-08-26.sbd.miller-rolfe.32303.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 178 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd1971-08-26.175566.sbd.remaster.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 30 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd71-08-26.sbd.dopey.1559.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 178 min; rated 4.16/5 by 32 [3]. Said about its sound: Jerry's mix is low, but overall sound is sweet and good; Phil bombs present; first two discs have channel issues, third is great; Sound quality is good but not stellar, with a few warts [3][14][15][19][23]
- **gd1971-08-26.sbd.fixed.miller-rolfe.32351.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 30 songs; 178 min; rated 4/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Static present in one channel during the last second of a song [4]

## Around the show

- Broadway local train rumbling one block away during the performance [12]
- IRT train floor bubbled like Terminator 2 while traveling to the venue [13]
- Mickey was on sabbatical, leaving only five musicians on stage [13]
- Friend taped both this show and a prior Jefferson Airplane gig [16]
- Crowd listened to Airplane tapes with car doors open in line [16]
- Reviewer was 14 years old attending high school in the Bronx [17]
- Friend Dan attended on crutches after injuring his foot playing frisbee [18]
- Last time the reviewer saw Pigpen perform live [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-08-26.sbd.miller-rolfe.32303.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Steve Rolfe; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7in @ 7.5ips 1/2 Track) -> DCassette (Tascam 122mkII) -> Dat (48k) D [1]
- **gd1971-08-26.175566.sbd.remaster.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 15, 1986; source: SBD > Master Reel (7in @ 7.5ips 1/2 Track) > Cassette (Tascam 122mkII) > DAT (48k) [2]. Also: Remaster of shnid=32303, with patch source recorded by Marty Weingberg [2]
- **gd71-08-26.sbd.dopey.1559.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Lineage: SDBMR to DAT to WAV to SHN via Dopey [3]
- **gd1971-08-26.sbd.fixed.miller-rolfe.32351.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7in @ 7.5ips 1/2 Track) -> DCassette (Tascam 122mkII) -> Dat (48k) D [4]. Also: Steve Rolfe provided the source DAT for this fixed version [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.rarenewspapers.com: [Grateful Dead, Black Sabbath & more in 1971....... | RareNewspapers.com](https://www.rarenewspapers.com/newspaper/705281-grateful-dead-black-sabbath-more-in-1971) [25]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Gaelic Park - August 26, 1971](https://www.dead.net/show/august-26-1971) [26]
